required.name: P1: NOP attempted bitfield write
required.description: Prevents mission completion from cascading unlock bits

required.name: P2: Validator bypass (JZ to JMP)
required.description: Mission validator always takes available path, no prerequisites block

required.name: Function entry fix (push ecx)
required.description: Fixes function prologue at VA 0x17EE00 — int3 padding replaced with push ecx

required.name: Height/Y-position fix
required.description: Corrects outlier Y-coordinate 100.0 to 3.7986 in position data table (.rdata)

required.name: Force level load — mov eax,[global]
required.description: Replaces dynamic level pointer read with hardcoded global address. Default address is Sawmill. The starting_level setting overwrites the address bytes.

required.name: Force level load — NOP cmovne
required.description: NOPs the conditional override so forced level is always used

settings.name: Starting level address
settings.description: Overwrites the 4-byte global address inside the force-level-load patch. The address selects which level global to read.
